benefits.name: Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite status, including a 25% points bonus on eligible hotel purchases.
benefits.terms: Automatic with card membership; requires linking a Marriott Bonvoy account.

benefits.name: 15 Elite Night Credits
benefits.description: 15 Elite Night Credits toward the next level of Marriott Bonvoy Elite status each calendar year.

benefits.name: Annual Free Night Award
benefits.description: 1 Free Night Award (redemption level at or under 50,000 Marriott Bonvoy points) after spending $15,000 in eligible purchases in a calendar year.
benefits.terms: Requires $15,000 in eligible calendar-year spend. Resort fees may apply.

benefits.name: 1,000 Bonus Points Per Stay
benefits.description: 1,000 Marriott Bonvoy bonus points per paid eligible stay booked directly with Marriott at participating properties.

benefits.name: Car Rental Loss and Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Coverage for damage or theft of most rental vehicles up to $50,000, when the rental agency's own coverage is declined and the rental is paid for entirely with the card.

benefits.name: Trip Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $300 per trip for reasonable additional expenses when a round trip paid entirely with the card is delayed more than 12 hours, up to 2 claims per 12-month period.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers eligible purchases against theft or accidental damage for 90 days, up to $10,000 per purchase and $50,000 per calendar year.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends eligible original manufacturer's warranties of 5 years or less by an additional year.

earningRates.terms: Worldwide restaurants and U.S. supermarkets, on up to $15,000 in combined purchases per calendar year, then 2x.
